SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.description, r.data_scope, r.role_type, r.is_system, r.status, r.tenant_id, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, r.sort_order AS roleSort, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.del_flag = 0) AS SIGNED) AS userCount, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_role_menu rm WHERE rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.del_flag = 0) AS SIGNED) AS menuCount, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.del_flag = 0) AS SIGNED) AS permissionCount FROM agri_md_role r LEFT JOIN agri_md_tenant t ON CAST(t.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = r.tenant_id
ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.description, r.data_scope, r.role_type, r.is_system, r.status, r.tenant_id, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, r.sort_order AS roleSort, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.del_flag = 0) AS SIGNED) AS userCount, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_role_menu rm WHERE rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.del_flag = 0) AS SIGNED) AS menuCount, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_md_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.del_flag = 0) AS SIGNED) AS permissionCount FROM agri_md_role r LEFT JOIN agri_md_tenant t ON CAST(t.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = r.tenant_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.del_flag = 0

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) AS total, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS active, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS disabled, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_system = 1 OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.role_type, '')) = 'system' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS systemRoles, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (r.is_system = 1 OR LOWER(COALESCE(r.role_type, '')) = 'system') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS customRoles, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.tenant_id IS NULL OR TRIM(r.tenant_id) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS platformRoles, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.tenant_id REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS subjectRoles, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.tenant_id) <> '' AND r.tenant_id NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SIGNED) AS legacyRoles FROM agri_md_role r
